headline: Record revenue and margin gains power a sharp profit jump
summary_short: CSX posted record quarterly revenue of $3,935M, up 10.1% y/y and 13.0% q/q, as operating income rose 17.4% y/y to $1,506M and diluted EPS grew 22.7% y/y to $0.54.
summary_long: Revenue growth was driven by higher fuel surcharge revenue plus increased volume and pricing across merchandise, intermodal, and coal; total volume rose 6% y/y, led by 9% intermodal growth. Operating margin expanded 240bps to 38.3% as operating income grew faster than revenue. EBITDA rose to $1,942M (+12.1% y/y) and net income increased to $1,002M (+20.9% y/y), lifting diluted EPS to $0.54 (+22.7% y/y). Cash and short-term investments both grew sharply q/q, and shareholders' equity rose to $14,088M (+13.8% y/y). Weighted diluted shares were roughly flat. The release states no forward guidance for the next quarter.
